description: An almost disjoint family of subsets of the naturals containing two distinct members cannot be independent.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.almost_disjoint_not_independent (A : Set (Set ℕ))
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint A) (hpair : ∃ S ∈ A, ∃ T ∈ A, S ≠ T) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.IsIndependent A
